quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for hissing steam and the fast footsteps of commuters in an urban setting.
quests.explanation: Pavement steam vents and rushing commuter footsteps in a high-tech city identify a cyber city.
quests.textToSpeak: Steam hisses from pavement vents as crowds of tech workers rush along the elevated walkway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sound of running water in a quiet wooded environment.
quests.explanation: A babbling brook and pine-filtered wind together are classic interior forest sounds.
quests.textToSpeak: A babbling brook can be heard clearly through the pines as a soft breeze passes through.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a resonant metallic thud felt through the structure of a spacecraft.
quests.explanation: Docking-clamp thuds felt through a spacecraft hull identify a vessel operating in space.
quests.textToSpeak: A metallic thud reverberates through the hull as the docking clamps engage.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the smooth mechanical whir of a precision robotic instrument arm.
quests.explanation: Precision robotic arm movement and glowing incubators are signature features of a research lab.
quests.textToSpeak: A robotic arm shifts smoothly to transfer sample vials between glowing incubators.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the synchronized footfalls of many people running together.
quests.explanation: Formation running in lockstep rhythm is a distinctly military training sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Soldiers jog in close formation, their boots striking the ground in perfect unison.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the quiet hum of a submersible motor in complete underwater darkness.
quests.explanation: Bioluminescent creatures and submersible motor hum identify the deep ocean.
quests.textToSpeak: Bioluminescent jellyfish pulse silently outside the submersible viewport in the black water.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the deep hush of a thick-walled stone chamber with faint ventilation.
quests.explanation: Cool damp stone air and near-total silence identify an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: Cool damp air and the faint smell of stone fill this silent underground archive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the faint hum of small tracking motors in a spacecraft environment.
quests.explanation: Solar-panel tracking motors identify an orbital station operating in space.
quests.textToSpeak: Tiny motors hum as the solar panels slowly adjust their angle toward the sun.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sharp crack of fabric snapping in the wind near a sacred site.
quests.explanation: Prayer flags snapping in mountain wind are almost exclusively found at Buddhist temple sites.
quests.textToSpeak: Colorful prayer flags snap in the wind, their fabric cracking in rhythmic bursts.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for repeated electronic beeps as people move through security screening.
quests.explanation: Security scanner beeps at regular intervals are definitive of an airport checkpoint.
quests.textToSpeak: Security scanners emit a steady sequence of beeps as passengers pass through the checkpoint.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a very low-frequency engine vibration on a transit platform.
quests.explanation: A diesel locomotive idling at a platform creates a characteristic low-frequency thrum.
quests.textToSpeak: A heavy diesel locomotive idles at the platform, its engine a deep, bone-deep vibration.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for quiet squeaking wheels in a near-silent, book-filled interior.
quests.explanation: A squeaking library cart in an atmosphere of hush is characteristic of a public library.
quests.textToSpeak: A librarian pushes a cart of returned books, its small wheels squeaking softly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a commercial public-address announcement inside a large echoing indoor space.
quests.explanation: Promotional PA announcements identify the retail environment of a shopping mall.
quests.textToSpeak: A timed promotional announcement chimes and echoes through the busy shopping atrium.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for live piano music played quietly during a meal.
quests.explanation: Live piano jazz accompanying quiet dinner conversation is a hallmark of fine dining.
quests.textToSpeak: A pianist in the corner plays a soft jazz standard as guests settle into their seats.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for energetic dog barking in a large open outdoor space.
quests.explanation: Dogs playing fetch in a grassy open area is a classic city park sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Dogs bark joyfully as their owners throw frisbees across the sunlit lawn.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for quick, hushed footsteps on a smooth institutional floor.
quests.explanation: Fast, padded footsteps on linoleum in a setting requiring quiet identify a hospital ward.
quests.textToSpeak: Nurses walk quickly down the corridor, their padded shoes nearly silent on the linoleum.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the high-pitched whine of a heavy motor lifting a great weight.
quests.explanation: Crane motor whine while lifting structural steel identifies an active construction site.
quests.textToSpeak: A crane motor strains as it hoists a massive steel beam slowly into the frame.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the rhythmic chug of a tractor engine moving across open farmland.
quests.explanation: The steady chug of a tractor engine in an open field is unmistakably a working farm sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Tractors move through the field at a steady pace, turning the dark soil as they go.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for children screaming joyfully as water rushes across sand.
quests.explanation: Children playing in wave surf is an instantly recognizable sandy beach sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Children shriek and laugh as a cold wave breaks and rushes across the flat beach.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for effortful, audible breathing in a cold, silent, high-altitude environment.
quests.explanation: Labored breathing and cold thin air indicate a high mountain peak.
quests.textToSpeak: At this altitude the air is so thin that every step comes with a labored breath.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for layered insect sounds beneath the rustling of a forest canopy.
quests.explanation: A dense insect chorus under a sunlit forest canopy identifies a healthy dense forest.
quests.textToSpeak: Afternoon sunlight filters through the canopy as insects create a rhythmic hum below.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the electrical hum of large outdoor screens and rain on a hard surface.
quests.explanation: Flickering neon advertising screens and rain on urban streets identify a futuristic cyber city.
quests.textToSpeak: Massive neon screens flicker with advertisements, casting a blue wash over the wet street.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a continuous mechanical hiss from a life-support system inside a spacecraft.
quests.explanation: An oxygen-recycler hiss to maintain breathable air is specific to a spacecraft environment.
quests.textToSpeak: The spacecraft's oxygen recycler hisses softly, maintaining the cabin's breathable atmosphere.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for quiet, specialized conversation near low-glow digital displays.
quests.explanation: Low-voiced data discussion near holographic displays identifies a high-tech research lab.
quests.textToSpeak: Scientists exchange hushed technical observations over softly glowing display tablets.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for multiple diesel engines idling together in an open yard.
quests.explanation: Multiple idling armored-vehicle engines in a yard identify a military installation.
quests.textToSpeak: Armored vehicles idle in the yard, their diesel engines filling the air with a deep thrum.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the hiss and fizz of gas escaping from the ocean floor under pressure.
quests.explanation: Hydrothermal vent gas bubbles identify the deep ocean floor.
quests.textToSpeak: Gas bubbles fizz and hiss as they rise from a hydrothermal vent on the sea floor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for mechanical gears turning and chains rattling inside a stone-walled space.
quests.explanation: Gear mechanisms and rattling chains in a stone enclosure indicate an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: A gear mechanism turns and chains rattle behind the thick stone wall of the chamber.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the quiet hum of station life-support as you observe Earth from above.
quests.explanation: Observing Earth rotating below from a window identifies an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: Through the cupola window, the Earth spins slowly below in absolute silence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a small, clear bell ring repeated in slow deliberate intervals.
quests.explanation: A ritual handbell signal before morning prayers is found at ancient temple sites.
quests.textToSpeak: A small handbell rings three deliberate times to signal the beginning of morning prayers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for automated robotic-sounding PA voices announcing flight departures.
quests.explanation: Synthetic PA voices announcing flight departures identify an airport terminal.
quests.textToSpeak: Synthetic robotic voices announce departure gates in the futuristic terminal hub.
